```sql
WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT
        "Block",
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_count,
        COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "Block"), 0) AS overdue_percentage
    FROM shg_loan_register
    WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'
    GROUP BY "Block"
)
SELECT
    "Block",
    overdue_count,
    overdue_percentage
FROM overdue_loans
ORDER BY overdue_percentage DESC
```
